===[[Ahafo Region]]===
[[File:Ahafo in Ghana 2018.svg|thumb|Ahafo Region in Ghana]]
The Ahafo Region of Ghana was created by a referendum in December 2018.  The regional capital is Goaso.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Know the 16 regional capitals of Ghana|url=https://www.businessghana.com/|website=BusinessGhana|access-date=2020-05-27}}</ref> It was part of the then [[Brong-Ahafo Region]] and contains 6 districts, 3 municipal and 3 ordinary districts.
